# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.6.0

Version 1.6.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.5.3

**A full touch mode: play with your fingers on the world, no pad on the screen.** Choose it under pause menu →
**Settings** → **Gameplay** → **Touch controls** → **Full touch** (the on-screen pad stays the default on Android):

- **Moving**: tap the ground to walk there; keep a finger held to run to where it is; drag to run that way.
- **Villagers**: tap one to walk up and talk; while a message is up, a tap goes on; tap a choice to pick it.
- **Things**: tap one to walk up and use it: items, flowers and weeds are picked up, trees shaken (or chopped with the
  axe), signs, mailboxes and furniture used. With the shovel, a tap on the ground digs there or fills the hole; with
  the net or the rod, a tap nearby swings or casts that way. A tap on yourself is A.
- **Icons**: the pause menu, a save and the gamepad at the top left, the map and the pockets at the top right. The
  pictures are new, drawn from shapes for this port.
- **The pockets and the map by touch**: tap a slot for its commands (or to put down what the hand holds), tap a
  command, drag an item to another slot (to swap) or onto yourself (to wear, eat or hold it); tap an acre of the map.
  The X closes them.
- **Tools**: the strip at the top middle shows the tool in your hand and the ones before and after it in your
  pockets; swipe it left or right, or tap a side, to take another one out at once.
- **Furniture mode** in your own house (the chair icon): tap a piece to pick it, drag it to move it (it snaps to the
  floor's units, green where it fits, red where it does not), turn it with the arrows, put it in your pockets with the
  satchel, or drag a piece from your pockets (the row at the bottom) onto the floor. What a piece holds or has on it, a
  lamp's switch and a gyroid's step go with it; a piece with things in or on it stays out of the pockets. The changes
  are your house's, saved with the town as if you had moved the pieces yourself.
- **The title screen**: a touch anywhere starts the game (START); the talk and choices that follow go by taps.
- Anything else that wants buttons (other menus such as letters, the calendar or the designs, the NES games) brings
  the GameCube pad up by itself; the gamepad icon shows it whenever you want it.

**The on-screen pad can be rearranged.** Under **Touch controls**, **Edit pad layout...** shows the pad over the
game: drag a button, the D-pad or the stick to move it, pick one and make it bigger or smaller (50-200%), **Reset
this** or **Reset all** to put it back. The stick takes the corner it is moved to.

**Touches on the menus land where they are aimed.** On a window wider than 4:3 a touch on the game's own menus (the
Korean editor's keyboard, now also the pockets) could land a step to the side, depending on what the game had drawn
last; it no longer does.

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's and v1.5.3's: they can be in the same room. 32-bit and 64-bit
  players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.6.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.6.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.6.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.6.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

Played by script with touches on a 1280x720 window (the full touch mode's fingers given by the script):

- **Moving**: a tap walked the player to the tapped point (within 3 units); a finger held ran to it; a drag ran the
  way it was dragged.
- **A villager**: a tap on them walked the player up, turned to them and started the talk; taps went through it, and
  a tap on the second line of a choice window chose it.
- **Things**: a tap on an apple on the ground walked up and put it in the pockets; with the shovel a tap on the grass
  dug a hole there and a second tap filled it.
- **Tools**: swipes on the strip took out the next and the previous tool, and put the one in hand away into a free
  pocket.
- **The pockets**: a tap on the apple's slot moved the cursor there and opened its commands, a tap on **그만둘래**
  (Quit) closed them; a drag took the net from the first slot to the last; the X closed the pockets. **The map**: a tap
  on an acre selected it, a tap beside the map closed it.
- **Furniture mode** in the player's house: a piece dragged from the pockets onto the floor was placed, turned, moved
  to another unit and put back in the pockets, the house's data changing each time and the room built again from it;
  a drag onto another piece was refused with a message.
- The calendar menu and the gamepad icon brought the GameCube pad up; **Edit pad layout** moved A and the stick and
  saved them to `touch_layout`.
- **The title screen** in the full touch mode: one touch in the middle of the screen started the game, taps went
  through the talk that follows, and a tap on a choice picked it; no pad came up.
- An independent review of the change found these, fixed before this release: the title screen took no taps in the
  full touch mode (its demo is played like the town; now a touch anywhere is START); the pockets opened to sell, give or
  send ignored a tap on another slot (they now take it within the table the cursor is in, as the stick does); a line
  tapped as a command list closed could be chosen in the next list; a walk asked for just before a door went on after
  it; and in the furniture mode a gyroid's step could be lost or mixed with an old one, an edit could outlive the mode,
  a balloon, the frog and the stego skull were put down facing another way than the game puts them, and the strip of
  tools would throw away a hand flower or a My Design umbrella in hand (it now leaves them to the pockets' menu).
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots, logged positions and saves on v1.5.3
  and on this version (921 screenshots), with touch off as in every release before.
- All unit tests pass; the decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.6.0, versionCode 10600); the four
  files hold the same files as v1.5.3's.

## Known limitations

- The full touch mode was checked with touches given by script on the desktop, not yet on a phone; the on-screen pad
  stays the default.
- In the full touch mode the pictures of the furniture in the furniture mode's row are the same armchair for every
  piece (the game's own item pictures are not used); the piece shows in the room as soon as it is placed.
- The furniture mode moves pieces on the floor; a piece standing on a table moves with the table, but is not picked on
  its own (put it on another table with the game's own controls).
- The limitations of v1.5.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.5.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
